label: Church organ, principal chorus, recorded in its building
audition_title: libsonare church organ vs the sampled reference
_registration: The single most important setting, and the one nothing downstream can recover from. libsonare's program 19 bank 0 is a six-rank principal chorus - 16', 8', 4', 2 2/3', 2', 1 3/5', no reeds - and `rank_count` is not a tunable, so the number of ranks and their footages are fixed. A reference registered differently is not a harder fit, it is a different instrument: the partial stack would be off by whole ranks and the only knobs that could answer are the six rank levels, which would be spent hiding a registration mismatch. Set the reference to a principal chorus of that footage list and nothing else.
_other_registrations: Program 19 has two more, reachable with `--bank`: bank 8 is three flute ranks and bank 16 a full organ with reeds. Each is its own patch with its own knobs, so each wants its own capture with the reference registered to match - this one is bank 0. `autofit.py --program 19 --dump-knobs` lists the banks a program has.
_dry: An organ is voiced for its building - the room is the instrument, not an effect on it - so the capture keeps it. `dry` is off, which means the plugin's own effect sections are left as the preset set them. The consequence downstream is that the room has to be treated as a nuisance parameter rather than ignored: `autofit` measures it off the note tails and convolves the MODEL to match before any metric is taken. Without that the release delta reads as seconds of pipe speech that no pipe has.
_stimulus: A pipe holds until the key is released, so the gate only has to outlast the speech transient and give the steady state somewhere to be measured; the metrics take their sustain window between 0.6 s and 1.8 s after onset. What needs the length is the other end - a nave carries four seconds after the key comes up, and a tail cut short reads as a fast release.
_timbres: One registration per timbre. Two instruments of different scaling say more here than two presets of the same one, because the fit answers to the partial stack and that is set by the pipe scale as much as by the stop list.
_notes: Every sixth semitone across the manual compass. The extremes carry the ranks rather than the fundamental: at C2 the 16' rank is the lowest thing in the sound and at C7 the 1 3/5' is at 8 kHz, so an error in either is only visible at the end it lives at. A midrange-only grid would report a chorus that is wrong at both ends as correct.
_velocities: One. A pipe organ has no velocity response at all - the key opens a pallet and the wind either flows or does not - so a second point would measure the reference's MIDI implementation rather than the instrument. The harness reports the consequence rather than hiding it: with the velocity axis held fixed, `--diagnose` counts it off the probe rows and marks every dynamics knob unprobed instead of dead. That the model must also be flat across velocity is a claim worth checking separately, not a dimension to gate on.
_dimensions: Three exclusions, each measured rather than assumed. `damper` is out because with the building in the capture it measures the nave's RT60, and a bound recorded from a reverberation time fails on the day the model's release is finally right. `vel_range` is out because there is one velocity. `decay` is out because a chorus does not hold a steady level - its ranks beat against each other, and over the measured window that is 9.8 dB peak to peak at C2 - so the linear fit returns the beat's phase rather than a decay: the same note reads +5.1 dB/s over the first half of its own sustain and +0.8 over the second. The number is real and the modulation is part of the sound, but it is not a decay, and the model's ranks beat against a tuning the reference's know nothing about. `--w-env` should stay at zero in a fit here for the same reason. `stretch` is kept with a caveat: at C2 one FFT bin of the sustain window is about 22 cents, so the tuning column down there is quantisation as much as temperament.
_identity: Which product this is captured from lives in the untracked sibling `pipe_organ.local.json`: the plugin's component triple and each timbre's preset. Everything here is the method. Re-capturing needs the overlay; scoring, fitting and diagnosing read `reference/pipe_organ.json` and need nothing.
